Zoya Desai
Senior Talent Acquisition Leader | Bangalore
zoya.desai948@example.com | +91 9909003656

Strategic talent acquisition professional focused on building high-impact teams through data-driven sourcing and candidate experience improvements. Strong track record partnering with engineering and product leaders to shorten time-to-hire and increase offer acceptance rates. Comfortable running end-to-end hiring programs and scaling processes across fast-growing organizations.

Experience

Saffron Bank, Nov 2025 - Present
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (Hybrid)
- Led sourcing for 40+ roles across engineering and risk teams using LinkedIn Recruiter to build a qualified pipeline, improving qualified candidate-to-interview ratio by 35% within six months.
- Designed and implemented structured interview guides and scorecards in Confluence, reducing hiring committee feedback cycles by 25% and increasing hiring manager satisfaction scores.
- Managed offer process and negotiation for senior hires, achieving a 88% offer acceptance rate and reducing average time-to-offer by 18% through streamlined workflows tracked in Jira.
- Coordinated candidate feedback and onboarding handoffs with hiring managers and HR, maintaining candidate NPS above 60 for all completed requisitions.

Kite Learning, Jun 2023 - Oct 2025
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote)
- Owned full-cycle Recruitment for product and learning roles; deployed targeted outreach via LinkedIn Recruiter that tripled passive candidate engagement and led to a 40% increase in hires from referrals and direct sourcing.
- Created centralized role folders in Confluence and version-controlled hiring materials with Git to maintain consistency across hiring teams and reduce duplicate work.
- Implemented Jira-based hiring trackers and dashboards to monitor pipeline health, cutting time-to-fill for high-priority roles by 22%.
- Trained hiring managers on structured interviewing and bias mitigation, improving interview-to-offer conversion by 15%.

Capgemini, Nov 2022 - May 2023
Talent Acquisition Specialist (On-site)
- Sourced and closed mid- to senior-level technical consultants using LinkedIn Recruiter and targeted campus outreach; filled 30+ roles across cloud and middleware practices in six months.
- Standardized recruitment documentation in Confluence and stored candidate feedback iterations with Git to enable auditability and faster decision-making.
- Championed a Jira workflow for requisition approvals, reducing administrative bottlenecks and accelerating candidate progression through stages by 20%.
- Partnered with practice leads to refine role profiles and compensation benchmarking, improving offer acceptance for critical skill sets.

Swiggy, Sep 2016 - Oct 2022
Recruiter (On-site)
- Managed high-volume Talent Acquisition for operations and tech hiring, deploying LinkedIn Recruiter for scalable sourcing and achieving monthly hiring targets consistently during peak hiring cycles.
- Built and maintained talent pools and referral programs documented in Confluence, increasing referral hires by 30% year-over-year.
- Tracked all requisitions and interview feedback in Jira, improving time-to-hire on core roles by 27% through process improvements and prioritization.
- Collaborated with business stakeholders to run targeted recruitment campaigns and campus drives, producing measurable increases in candidate pipeline quality.

Projects
- Interview Toolkit Repository — Built a version-controlled set of role-specific interview guides and scoring rubrics using Git and Confluence to standardize evaluations across hiring teams.
- Hiring Dashboard Implementation — Implemented Jira dashboards and custom reports to monitor pipeline metrics (time-to-fill, stage conversion) leading to actionable process changes.

Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter, Git, Jira, Confluence

Education
B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
